id./param/scenario/cs/b_150_cs_120.pack|cs_:
"No cutting in line, Erik, dear.
  ...{var:1}, darling, let us help too.

"The previous Luminary forged the sword
  together with his companions.
  We'll not be outdone.

"Yes. This isn't your fight alone.
  It's the battle of all of us...

"The new Sword of Light...
  Let us pour our hearts into its blade.
"{var:1}, please use our strength as well.

"{var:1}, thanks to you I atoned
  and saved Mia. Now it's my turn
  to lend you my strength!

"{var:1}, watch Sylvando's finest show,
  one to save the world
  and make everyone smile!

"Eleanor... Irwin...
  Watch over us, I beg you.
  May victory and joy be your child's!

"I thought protecting you was my fight.
  ...Perhaps not. Protecting everyone
  alongside you is my fight.

"{var:1}, I swear as a knight:
  no matter the foe, I'll remain
  the shield of hope to the very end!

"Your clumsy little sister has grown a bit.
  So please, don't worry...
  I'll fight alongside {var:1}!

"The Sword of Light...
  Let's see just how good it is.
  Go on, {var:1}, take it.

"Allies to fight beside, a divine vessel
  to fly the skies, and a new Sword of Light.
  We're finally ready to face Mordegon.

"Yeah, this is the home stretch.
  ...Let's go to the Fortress of Fear!
